about:
Stengel Bros. Inc. operates from Whitehall Township, Pennsylvania. The company has been in business for over 43 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company distributes a broad range of suspension components including leaf springs, air ride suspensions, lift axles, truck bumpers, shock absorbers, coil springs, helper kits, trailer axles, U-bolts, and wheel centering products. It carries parts from name‑brand manufacturers such as Monroe, Goodyear, Link Manufacturing, Reyco Granning, Hendrickson, Watson & Chalin, and others. Stengel Bros. also offers custom U‑bolt fabrication for non‑standard applications and ships replacement air springs and heavy‑duty springs nationwide via UPS.

Primary customers operate in commercial trucking, trailer manufacturing and repair, light‑truck and SUV aftermarket, RV and motorhome markets, and utility trailer segments. The catalog references specific applications for Mack, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Volvo, Freightliner, International, and Navistar trucks; Reyco, Neway, Fruehauf, Hutch, and Trailmobile trailer suspensions; and Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Dodge, Toyota, Nissan, Mitsubishi, and Mazda light trucks and SUVs.

Stengel Bros. emphasizes its longevity — over four decades in the industry — and a guarantee on all parts and services. Nationwide shipping on stocked air springs and heavy‑duty springs, plus the ability to produce special U‑bolts to order, are highlighted as key service differentiators.
